title: Small JavaScript normalization fix
final_response:
`uniqueLabels` now trims each string, drops empty/whitespace-only values, dedupes case-insensitively while keeping the first spelling seen, and returns results in original (unsorted) order. The CommonJS export (`module.exports = { uniqueLabels }`) is unchanged, and KEEP.txt was left untouched.

`node test_visible.js` output: `visible tests PASS`. Extra spot checks confirmed order/spelling preservation (e.g. `['  Foo ','foo','BAR  ','','bar','baz'] → ["Foo","BAR","baz"]`).
